name: io.github.filipmihajlov/proceni
title: ProCeni: grocery prices in North Macedonia
description: Live grocery and drugstore prices from 17 chains in North Macedonia: search, compare, deals, baskets

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find a grocery or drugstore product in Macedonian supermarkets. Returns matching products grouped across stores (same product = one group), the cheapest current price and store, how many stores carry it, and a product_id for compare_prices. Use Macedonian Cyrillic terms where possible (e.g. 'кашкавал', 'нескафе голд').

query.description: Product name, brand and size, e.g. 'нескафе голд 100г' or 'Persil 3l'.

store.description: Optional chain to limit to, e.g. 'ramstore', 'vero', 'kam'.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Every store's current price for one product (the product_id from search_products), cheapest first: regular and sale price, sale end date, market, when it was checked, the 90-day low, and how much you save versus the most expensive store.

tools.name: top_discounts
tools.description: The biggest current price cuts (by %), across all chains or for one chain. Shows old and new price, sale end date and whether it is the cheapest price for that product anywhere.

tools.name: cheapest_basket
tools.description: Price a shopping list (up to 20 items) in every store: the total per store, the best single store, and the cheapest split across stores. Pass product_id for exact items (from search_products) or a query and the best-covered matching product is used. Check the matched product names in the result.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Supermarket and drugstore chains ProCeni tracks, with how many products had a price checked in the last 30 days and how many are on sale.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ProCeni products by name. Returns ids for fetch. Same data as search_products, in the shape ChatGPT deep research expects.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: All current store prices for one product id returned by search.
